{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove any commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the first few values after conversion
print("First 5 converted revenue values:", sales_df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Confirm the dtype is now float
print("Revenue dtype after conversion:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)"}
